#Import Library 

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(limma)
library(factoextra)
library(MASS)


Figure_Export <- file.path(here(),"Figures")

Data_Import <- file.path(here(), "Data")
```


#Import the GSE32863 Matrix

```{r}
#Import Processed Counts
Matrix <- readRDS(file = file.path(Data_Import,"GSE32863_Processed_Data.rds"))

#Import Metadata
Metadata <- readRDS(file = file.path(Data_Import,"GSE32863_Metadata.rds"))

Cols_of_Interest <- Metadata %>% dplyr::select(source_name_ch1,
                                               batch = characteristics_ch1.1,
                                               beadchip = characteristics_ch1.5,
                                               beadchip_2 = characteristics_ch1.6,
                                               smoking = characteristics_ch1.13,
                                               reoccurence = characteristics_ch1.15,
                                               sex = characteristics_ch1.10,
                                               race = characteristics_ch1.11)


```

#Run PCA Quality Checking prior to running Differential Expression Analysis

Quality Checking should occur to make sure that there are no batch effects or other factors that may need to be accounted for prior to differential expression analysis. An example would be any batch effects that might confound the analysis.

```{r}
pca_matrix <- Matrix %>%
  t()

#Check the metadata alignment of the column and rownames of the Matrix and then look at biplot
identical(rownames(pca_matrix), Metadata$geo_accession)

PCA <- prcomp(pca_matrix)

#Look at Biplot

#Faceted by Batch

fviz_pca_biplot(X = PCA,
                geom.var = c(""),
                habillage = Cols_of_Interest$batch,
                label = "none")

#Faceted by Sex

fviz_pca_biplot(X = PCA,
                geom.var = c(""),
                habillage = Cols_of_Interest$sex,
                label = "none")

#Faceted by Race

fviz_pca_biplot(X = PCA,
                geom.var = c(""),
                habillage = Cols_of_Interest$race,
                label = "none")

#Faceted by Reoccurence
fviz_pca_biplot(X = PCA,
                geom.var = c(""),
                habillage = Cols_of_Interest$reoccurence,
                label = "none")

#By Beadchip
fviz_pca_biplot(X = PCA,
                geom.var = c(""),
                habillage = Cols_of_Interest$beadchip,
                label = "none")

fviz_pca_biplot(X = PCA,
                geom.var = c(""),
                habillage = Cols_of_Interest$beadchip_2,
                label = "none")

#Faceted by Smoking
fviz_pca_biplot(X = PCA,
                geom.var = c(""),
                habillage = Cols_of_Interest$smoking,
                label = "none")

#By Tissue Type
fviz_pca_biplot(X = PCA,
                geom.var = c(""),
                habillage = Cols_of_Interest$source_name_ch1,
                label = "none")

ggsave(filename = file.path(Figure_Export, "PCA_GSE32863.png"))
```

#Run Differential Gene Expression by Limma()

Run differential gene expression on the micro array data using the limma() package with the use of the Limma user guide to help in the pipeline.
```{r}
#Create Factor to contrast samples that are a Lung Tumor Compared to Normal Tissue
design_factor <- factor(Cols_of_Interest$source_name_ch1, levels = c("Adjacent non-tumor lung", "Lung adenocarcinoma"))

#Set Basic Design for the Differential Analysis
Design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + design_factor)

#Set the names for the design (while ensuring the name is valid) since this appears to be an issue
valid_names <- make.names(unique(Cols_of_Interest$source_name_ch1))

colnames(Design) <- valid_names

#Run a Linear Fit 
fit <- lmFit(object = Matrix, design = Design)

#Make Contrasts (In this case, there is only 1 contrast)
contrasts <- makeContrasts(Lung.adenocarcinoma-Adjacent.non.tumor.lung, 
                           levels = Design)

#Re-run the linear fit based on the contrasts designed 
fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, contrasts) 
fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)


#Look at Differential Expression of Lung Tumor vs Normal Lung Tissue. It appears that the logFC is indeed log2 and then save the object.
Lung_Tumor_vs_Non_Tumor <- topTable(fit2, coef = NULL, number = length(rownames(Matrix)), adjust.method = "BH")


#Add Significance
Lung_Tumor_vs_Non_Tumor <- Lung_Tumor_vs_Non_Tumor %>%
  mutate(Significance = case_when(
    adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC > 1 ~ "Upregulated",
    adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC < -1 ~ "Downregulated",
    TRUE ~ "No Significance"
  ))

saveRDS(Lung_Tumor_vs_Non_Tumor, file = file.path(Data_Import, "GSE32863_DEG_results.rds"))

#Table of Significant Genes
significance_table <- table(Lung_Tumor_vs_Non_Tumor$Significance)


#Graph of the differential expression analysis

Lung_Tumor_vs_Non_Tumor %>%
ggplot(aes(x=logFC, y = -log10(adj.P.Val)))+
  geom_point(aes(color = Significance))+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed")+
  geom_vline(xintercept = -1, linetype = "dashed")+
  xlim(-5, 5)+
  ylim(0, 60)+
  theme(legend.position = "top",
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))+
  labs(title = "GSE32863", x = "log2FoldChange", y = "-log10(adj.pvalue)")+
  #labs(caption = paste0("# of Downregulated Genes: ", Up_or_down[1],", # of No Significance Genes: ", Up_or_down[2],", # of Upregulated Genes: ", Up_or_down[3]))+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Downregulated" = "#7CC5D6",
                                "No Significance" = "#2C2E2D",
                                "Upregulated" = "#E74033"))+
annotate("text", x = -3.75, y = 55, size = 3.5, label = paste("Downregulated Genes: ", significance_table [1]))+
annotate("text", x = 3.75, y = 55, size = 3.5, label = paste("Upregulated Genes: ", significance_table [3]))


ggsave(filename = file.path(Figure_Export, "DEG_GSE32863_Fig1A.png"))


```
